summary: Shared amendment-continuation helpers: amend-gate-decision maps workflow.audit_to_amend resolver envelopes to auto_split/force_ask/halt for z-audit-plan Phase 5, and amendment-brief renders spec_gap corrections plus premise_failure concerns for z-audit-plan and z-review-all; z-review-all's own Phase 6.5 auto-amend is severity-agnostic and does not consult the gate decision.

entry_points.summary: Render corrections and approach_concerns to deterministic markdown; Patched section always present, Worth-your-eyes only when non-empty.
Maps resolver envelope to auto_split, force_ask, or halt using five-rule precedence.
Calls config.py resolve-question workflow.audit_to_amend and passes envelope to amend-gate-decision.py.
Auto-amends spec_gap findings and renders premise_failure findings with amendment-brief.py.
Emits prose alignment summary instead of AskUserQuestion popup.
Auto-amends every amendment_proposal task via /z-amend --skip-user-gate, all severities; skips completed_task_contradiction and implementation_drift.
Subsection of Phase 6.5; builds corrections + approach_concerns JSON and writes archive amendment-brief.md.

invariants: Renderer format is shared by audit-plan and review-all.
Patched automatically line is always emitted.
Worth your eyes section is omitted when there are zero approach_concerns.
Gate decision source==none maps to auto_split.
force_ask in current z-audit-plan is rendered as prose alignment, not popup.
z-review-all Phase 6.5 is severity-agnostic for amendment_proposal disposition tasks and does not call amend-gate-decision.py or consult workflow.audit_to_amend.
z-review-all Phase 6.5 excludes completed_task_contradiction (superseding_task) and implementation_drift (candidate_task) items from auto-amend.
gotchas: amend-gate-decision.py prints token without trailing newline.
source==none is a common fresh-install path and auto-splits.
amendment-brief.py correction target is an artifact path/gloss, not necessarily an absolute path.
A missing approach_concerns list is treated as empty and omits the Worth-your-eyes section.

amend-gate-decision.py's module docstring (line 17) still says force_ask means '3-way interactive popup' -- stale; actual meaning is set by the calling skill (prose alignment summary in current z-audit-plan).
z-review-all Phase 6.6 is a ### subsection nested inside Phase 6.5, not a standalone ## phase header.
